releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* feat(compat): hide distant figures behind Lodistance's terrain by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/311
* docs(skills): add a skill for supporting far-terrain mods by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/312
* fix(forge): draw the debug panel and offline names on Forge 1.20.x by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/315
* feat(compat): read Far View's terrain for distant mobs by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/310
* feat(compat): read Ecstatic's terrain and match its far plane by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/309
* fix(compat): hand over to copies at the server's view distance with Bobby by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/316
* feat(ambient): add easter eggs 8 to 21, rework 6 and 7 by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/313


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/compare/v0.15.0...v0.16.0-dev.657

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* feat(ui): add Modrinth, CurseForge, Nexus Mods and website links by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/296
* feat(impostors): let Simplification Distance be turned off by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/302
* feat(ambient): change when easter eggs 3, 4 and 5 may come by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/299
* feat(players): show distant players gliding with an elytra by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/250
* fix(render): give distant mobs Distant Horizons' fog by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/297
* feat(ui): draw distance settings in the world while they are set by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/298
* perf(impostors): find saved sheets off the render thread, split the atlas by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/245
* feat(mobs): foresee the animals of unexplored land from the seed by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/295
* docs(changelog): rewrite every entry as player-facing release notes by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/303
* fix(impostors): picture Ice and Fire mobs at their real size and from every height by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/293
* fix(render): give distant mobs Distant Horizons' fog before 1.21.6 by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/304
* fix(offline): keep where players who logged off rest by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/247
* fix(mobs): stop still distant mobs gliding and trembling by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/306
* Enhance mob visibility and UI features for unexplored land by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/308


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/compare/v0.14.0...v0.15.0

## What's Changed
* feat(ui): add Modrinth, CurseForge, Nexus Mods and website links by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/296
* feat(impostors): let Simplification Distance be turned off by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/302
* feat(ambient): change when easter eggs 3, 4 and 5 may come by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/299
* feat(players): show distant players gliding with an elytra by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/250
* fix(render): give distant mobs Distant Horizons' fog by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/297
* feat(ui): draw distance settings in the world while they are set by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/298
* perf(impostors): find saved sheets off the render thread, split the atlas by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/245
* feat(mobs): foresee the animals of unexplored land from the seed by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/295
* docs(changelog): rewrite every entry as player-facing release notes by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/303
* fix(impostors): picture Ice and Fire mobs at their real size and from every height by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/293
* fix(render): give distant mobs Distant Horizons' fog before 1.21.6 by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/304
* fix(offline): keep where players who logged off rest by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/247
* fix(mobs): stop still distant mobs gliding and trembling by @clixmods in https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/pull/306


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MC-Skin-Creator/living-horizon/compare/v0.14.0...v0.15.0-dev.606

mods.name: Living Horizon
mods.description: Gives life to the distance: animals, villagers and other players stay visible far past your render distance, players who logged off live on where they left, and birds fill the sky. Works with the game alone or on top of Voxy and Distant Horizons.

readmeSummary: Living Horizon is a Minecraft mod that shows mobs and players far past your render distance. It draws them on the game's terrain and on the terrain of Voxy and Distant Horizons.
